source.timeframeNotes: deploy-free/incident-free k6 window; single-service agent app, entry scoped to crewai-deepseek-agent (co-tenant astronomy-shop dropped by scope)
queries: fetch spans | filter is_root_span && service.name=='crewai-deepseek-agent' | sort start_time asc | summarize takeFirst(span.name) by trace.id | summarize count() by entryOp  (front-end discovery -> single entry request, 301 traces)
fetch logs | filter k8s.container.name=='istio-proxy' over window -> 0 lines  (access-log probe, spans-only)
fetch spans | join [spans|sort start_time asc|summarize collectArray(span.name) by trace.id] on trace.id  (JOURNEY reconstruction: ReAct loop vs single LLM round)
fetch spans | summarize countIf(span.name=='execute_tool') by trace.id | summarize count() by usesTool  (archetype split via AGENTIC_TOOL_PATTERNS -> 96 agentic / 205 conversational)
fetch spans | filter span.name=='agent.turn' | summarize percentile(duration,50/95/99),avg by usesTool  (per-archetype baseline)
fetch spans | filter request | summarize count() by bin(start_time,1m)  (G3-B arrival curve; interior CoV 0.016 -> steady)
fetch spans | filter span.name=='agent.turn' | summarize sum(duration) / window  (observed concurrency 0.448)

journeys.description: Conversational — pure-LLM turn (single round); no tool. Reconstructed internal flow: crewai-deepseek-agent/request -> agent.turn -> Crew Created -> Task Created -> llm.call -> chat -> finalize -> message.sent

Agentic — tool-using turn (ReAct: LLM -> tool -> LLM); reaches execute_tool. Reconstructed internal flow: crewai-deepseek-agent/request -> agent.turn -> Crew Created -> Task Created -> llm.call -> chat -> execute_tool(web_search|calculator) -> Tool Usage -> llm.call -> chat -> (ReAct loop) -> finalize -> message.sent
